title: The Subtracted Mountain
working_title: The Subtracted Mountain — Kailasa, the temple they carved out of a cliff from the top down
logline: Twelve hundred years ago, in the basalt of the Deccan, a crew of artisans cut a full freestanding temple out of a living mountain from the summit downward — no mortar, no additions, no possibility of revision — and the honest, checkable story of how they did it is stranger and better than any of the legends told about it.
blueprint: narrative non-fiction — site companion (the non-fiction sibling of HBT Book III, The Temple in the Rock; same register as the estate's site books: official story played dead straight, checkable numbers, real-vs-claimed kept binding)
market: narrative non-fiction — ancient sites / history of engineering; the Why Files reader who wants the real thing sourced
